newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Police arrest 11 in Davos drug ring.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest 11 in Davos drug ring.

text.p: Police in the Alpine resort of Davos, where high-ranking business executives and top politicians are gathering for the annual World Economic Forum, have arrested 11 people for dealing in illegal drugs.
The district attorney for the Canton of Grisons said a drug ring with 43 people between the ages of 16 and 35 had been discovered, according to the Swiss News Agency (SDA).
The drug users have admitted consuming 3.5 kilos of heroin, 2.5 kilos of hash, 60 grammes of cocaine, 1,000 Ecstasy pills and at least 100 LSD trips, the attorneys' office said.
Most of the drugs were bought in the city of Zurich, once home to Europe's largest open drug scene, but some drugs were also bought in the city of Chur, the capital of Grisons.
Most of the arrested people were Swiss citizens living in Grisons, Swiss police said.
